bio: DoraWolf Studio works in education, infrastructure, and public buildings. The method is single: read the site first — its contour, its weather, its civic edges — and let form emerge from what is already there. Sustainable design and parametric modelling are the daily fabric of the practice, not a manifesto.

studio.name: DoraWolf Studio
studio.ethos: A small kit, used well. Restrained form. Public buildings owe the street a calm presence.

education.department: School of Civil Architecture and Environment
